name: NectoMax SEO Pages
author: Doug Hauenstein

sections.description:
NectoMax SEO Pages generates optimized location pages for service-area businesses. Enter your business info, services, and target cities — NectoMax creates professional SEO pages with unique AI-written copy, Schema.org structured data, and RankMath/Yoast optimization.

How it works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Run the setup wizard — enter your business, services, and cities
  3. Use Smart Lookup to enrich cities with local landmarks and resources
  4. Preview pricing and generate pages
  5. Pages appear in WordPress as drafts — review and publish

Free tier:

  • 1 city with up to 5 services — fully AI-generated, no payment required
  • Schema.org structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage)
  • RankMath and Yoast SEO meta optimization
  • Mobile-responsive design

Pro (subscription):

  • Unlimited cities and services
  • Internal linking web across all location pages
  • Content refresh (regenerate with fresh AI copy)
  • Discounted per-page rates
  • Priority generation queue

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to generate and manage SEO pages. By completing the setup wizard, you consent to the following connections:

NectoMax Content API

The plugin sends your business name, services, city names, and site URL to the NectoMax Content API for page generation, city enrichment, and pricing calculations.

  • API endpoint: api.nectomax.com
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

AI Content Generation

Page content is generated using AI (Claude by Anthropic) via the NectoMax API. No visitor data or personal information is sent to the AI service — only business information provided by the site administrator.

  • Anthropic Usage Policy

Stripe

Paid features (per-page purchases and subscriptions) are processed through Stripe’s hosted checkout. No payment card data is stored on your server or transmitted through the NectoMax API.

  • Stripe Terms of Service
  • Stripe Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload nectomax-seo to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the setup wizard that appears after activation
sections.faq:
Do I need a NectoMax account?

No separate account is needed. The plugin creates your account automatically when you complete the setup wizard. Your API key is stored securely in WordPress.

How many pages can I generate for free?

The free tier includes 1 city with up to 5 services. Each service gets a dedicated page plus a city hub page. Subscribe to add more cities and unlock internal linking.

Does it work with RankMath and Yoast?

Yes. NectoMax automatically sets SEO title, meta description, and focus keyword for both RankMath and Yoast SEO.

What is Smart Lookup?

Smart Lookup enriches your city data with local landmarks, neighborhoods, ZIP codes, and resource links — all pulled from public sources. This data is used to generate more locally-relevant page content.

Can I edit the generated pages?

Yes. Pages are created as standard WordPress pages (draft status). You can edit them like any other page before publishing.
